GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Active Listening, Interactive speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening, Interactive speaking.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening, Interactive speaking.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening, Interactive speaking.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening, Interactive speaking.

2. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Good day / hello
   B. Good night
   C. Please
   D. Thank you

3. When practising Listening for information, Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for information, Oral Expression.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for information, Oral Expression.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for information, Oral Expression.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for information, Oral Expression.

4. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Haus
   B. Wasser
   C. Schule
   D. Buch

5. When practising Extensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Extensive Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Extensive Reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Extensive Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Extensive Reading.

6. When practising Active Listening Interactive speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening Interactive speaking.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening Interactive speaking.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening Interactive speaking.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening Interactive speaking.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

13. In three clear sentences, explain Coherence Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
